headline: Is it time to replace my old windows?
articleBody: You know, sometimes your windows just aren't doing their job anymore, and it can really impact your home's comfort and energy bills. If you're noticing a constant draft, even when your windows are closed, that's a pretty strong signal. Old, inefficient windows often leak air, letting your conditioned air out and outdoor air in, which means your HVAC system has to work overtime. Another big indicator is condensation between the glass panes; that usually means the seals have failed, and your insulation is compromised. You might also see visible damage like warped frames, rotting wood, or difficulty opening and closing them. Beyond just function, older windows can make your home look dated, dragging down its curb appeal. Modern windows offer so many advantages, from improved energy efficiency to better security and noise reduction. If you're experiencing any of these issues, it's definitely worth having a professional take a look. They can give you an honest assessment of whether a repair is enough or if a full replacement is the smarter long-term investment.
